implementation.targetScope: useEffectEvent on React 19: native delegation when available, commit-only callback publication and a stable retained callable on the insertion-effect fallback.

changes: A single retained record owns the callable and its committed callback, removing the separate memo hook from the React 19.1 fallback.
React 19.2 native useEffectEvent is exported directly, preserving native commit and render-phase semantics.
React 19 guarantees insertion effects, so the older React layout-effect fallback and runtime dependency are omitted.
